vulns.description: Requests can leak cookies across domains during redirects in certain scenarios.
Requests vulnerable to information disclosure via improper handling of proxy credentials.
OpenSSL X.400 address type confusion leading to possible man-in-the-middle.
Jinja2 xmlattr filter vulnerable to cross-site scripting via attribute name injection.
Jinja2 html attribute filter vulnerable to cross-site scripting via attribute escaping bypass.
urllib3 vulnerable to cookie header injection when redirecting with special characters.
urllib3 request body desynchronization when using HTTP/1.1 keep-alive.
Flask vulnerable to resource exhaustion through large multipart form uploads.
Flask vulnerable to denial of service via specially crafted JSON request data.
Werkzeug vulnerable to denial of service via multipart form data with many parts.
Werkzeug development server vulnerable to denial of service via crafted requests.
